# Purpose and decision framework

This report tests whether the current WGCNA network is sensitive to retaining the
5,000, 10,000, or 15,000 most variable genes. It reconstructs each network from
the same 30 individual RNA-seq libraries while keeping the correlation method,
network type, module-detection settings, and planned site contrasts fixed. The
soft-thresholding power is re-evaluated separately for each gene set because the
connectivity distribution changes when additional genes enter the network.

The comparison is not designed to select the network with the highest
scale-free-topology fit alone. The final gene set should balance network
connectivity, module assignment, preservation of modules across nested gene
sets, site-stratified resampling stability, and computational reproducibility.
Annotation coverage is a secondary practical criterion. Site-contrast
significance, DEG overlap, enrichment yield, and chemistry are downstream
sensitivity results and cannot determine network parameters. Gene-set
preservation in this report is a
feature-selection sensitivity analysis and does not replace the site-stratified
resampling analysis required to evaluate module robustness.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
write_csv_safe <- function(x, path) {
  readr::write_csv(x, path, na = "")
  invisible(path)
}

save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, stem, width = 9, height = 6) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(stem, ".png"),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 320,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(stem, ".pdf"),
    plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
  if (requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      paste0(stem, ".svg"),
      plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      bg = "white"
    )
  }
  invisible(stem)
}

safe_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[!nzchar(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

safe_divide <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.finite(denominator) & denominator > 0,
    numerator / denominator,
    NA_real_
  )
}

hedges_g_two_group <- function(x_numerator, x_denominator) {
  x_numerator <- as.numeric(x_numerator)
  x_denominator <- as.numeric(x_denominator)
  x_numerator <- x_numerator[is.finite(x_numerator)]
  x_denominator <- x_denominator[is.finite(x_denominator)]

  n_num <- length(x_numerator)
  n_den <- length(x_denominator)
  if (n_num < 2L || n_den < 2L) return(NA_real_)

  pooled_df <- n_num + n_den - 2L
  pooled_var <- (
    (n_num - 1L) * stats::var(x_numerator) +
      (n_den - 1L) * stats::var(x_denominator)
  ) / pooled_df

  if (!is.finite(pooled_var) || pooled_var <= 0) return(NA_real_)

  cohen_d <- (
    mean(x_numerator) - mean(x_denominator)
  ) / sqrt(pooled_var)

  correction_j <- 1 - 3 / (4 * (n_num + n_den) - 9)
  correction_j * cohen_d
}

select_soft_power <- function(soft_tbl, target = 0.80) {
  eligible <- soft_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(.data$scale_free_fit),
      .data$scale_free_fit >= target
    )

  if (nrow(eligible) > 0L) {
    selected <- eligible %>%
      dplyr::slice_min(
        order_by = .data$power,
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      )
    rule <- paste0("lowest power reaching R2 >= ", target)
  } else {
    selected <- soft_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$scale_free_fit)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(.data$scale_free_fit),
        .data$power
      ) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)
    rule <- "highest available scale-free fit; target not reached"
  }

  if (nrow(selected) == 0L) {
    stop("No finite soft-threshold diagnostics were available.")
  }

  list(
    power = as.numeric(selected$power[[1]]),
    rule = rule,
    row = selected
  )
}

fit_one_module_contrast <- function(
  values,
  site_ids,
  numerator_site,
  denominator_site
) {
  contrast_df <- tibble::tibble(
    value = as.numeric(values),
    site_id = as.character(site_ids)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$site_id),
      is.finite(.data$value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      site_id = factor(
        .data$site_id,
        levels = unique(as.character(site_ids))
      )
    )

  numerator_values <- contrast_df$value[
    contrast_df$site_id == numerator_site
  ]
  denominator_values <- contrast_df$value[
    contrast_df$site_id == denominator_site
  ]

  if (
    length(numerator_values) < 2L ||
      length(denominator_values) < 2L
  ) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      n_numerator = length(numerator_values),
      n_denominator = length(denominator_values),
      numerator_mean = mean(numerator_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      denominator_mean = mean(denominator_values, na.rm = TRUE),
      eigengene_difference = NA_real_,
      conf_low = NA_real_,
      conf_high = NA_real_,
      hedges_g = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit <- stats::lm(value ~ 0 + site_id, data = contrast_df)
  beta_hat <- stats::coef(fit)
  beta_vcov <- stats::vcov(fit)
  residual_df <- stats::df.residual(fit)
  numerator_coef <- paste0("site_id", numerator_site)
  denominator_coef <- paste0("site_id", denominator_site)

  if (!all(c(numerator_coef, denominator_coef) %in% names(beta_hat))) {
    stop("A planned contrast site is absent from the common six-site model.")
  }

  contrast_vector <- stats::setNames(
    rep(0, length(beta_hat)),
    names(beta_hat)
  )
  contrast_vector[[numerator_coef]] <- 1
  contrast_vector[[denominator_coef]] <- -1
  estimate <- sum(contrast_vector * beta_hat)
  standard_error <- sqrt(as.numeric(
    t(contrast_vector) %*% beta_vcov %*% contrast_vector
  ))
  t_statistic <- estimate / standard_error
  p_value <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_statistic), df = residual_df)
  critical_t <- stats::qt(0.975, df = residual_df)

  tibble::tibble(
    n_numerator = length(numerator_values),
    n_denominator = length(denominator_values),
    numerator_mean = mean(numerator_values),
    denominator_mean = mean(denominator_values),
    eigengene_difference = estimate,
    conf_low = estimate - critical_t * standard_error,
    conf_high = estimate + critical_t * standard_error,
    hedges_g = hedges_g_two_group(
      numerator_values,
      denominator_values
    ),
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

fit_planned_module_contrasts <- function(
  eigengene_tbl,
  metadata_tbl,
  network_label,
  network_size,
  module_assignment,
  contrast_tbl
) {
  me_columns <- grep("^ME", names(eigengene_tbl), value = TRUE)
  me_columns <- setdiff(me_columns, "MEgrey")

  module_sizes <- module_assignment %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$module != "grey") %>%
    dplyr::count(
      .data$module,
      .data$module_label,
      name = "module_size"
    )

  result <- purrr::map_dfr(
    me_columns,
    function(current_module_label) {
      purrr::pmap_dfr(
        contrast_tbl,
        function(
          contrast,
          contrast_panel,
          numerator_site,
          denominator_site,
          contrast_role
        ) {
          test_row <- fit_one_module_contrast(
            values = eigengene_tbl[[current_module_label]],
            site_ids = metadata_tbl$site_id,
            numerator_site = numerator_site,
            denominator_site = denominator_site
          )

          test_row %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              network_label = network_label,
              network_size = network_size,
              module_label = current_module_label,
              module = stringr::str_remove(
                current_module_label,
                "^ME"
              ),
              contrast = contrast,
              contrast_panel = contrast_panel,
              numerator_site = numerator_site,
              denominator_site = denominator_site,
              contrast_role = contrast_role,
              .before = 1
            )
        }
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      module_sizes,
      by = c("module", "module_label")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q_global_network = stats::p.adjust(
        .data$p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q_within_contrast = stats::p.adjust(
        .data$p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fdr_supported = .data$q_global_network < fdr_threshold,
      large_nominal_effect =
        abs(.data$hedges_g) >= large_effect_abs_hedges_g &
        .data$p_value < nominal_p_threshold
    )

  result
}

run_network_for_gene_set <- function(
  requested_gene_n,
  ranked_gene_ids,
  expression_matrix,
  metadata_aligned
) {
  network_label <- paste0("G", requested_gene_n)
  message("Starting ", network_label, " network")

  selected_gene_ids <- utils::head(
    ranked_gene_ids,
    min(requested_gene_n, length(ranked_gene_ids))
  )

  dat_expr <- t(
    expression_matrix[selected_gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  rownames(dat_expr) <- metadata_aligned$sample_code

  gsg <- WGCNA::goodSamplesGenes(dat_expr, verbose = 0)
  if (!gsg$allOK) {
    dat_expr <- dat_expr[
      gsg$goodSamples,
      gsg$goodGenes,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  metadata_network <- metadata_aligned %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$sample_code %in% rownames(dat_expr)) %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(rownames(dat_expr), .data$sample_code))

  sft <- WGCNA::pickSoftThreshold(
    dat_expr,
    powerVector = candidate_powers,
    networkType = network_type,
    corFnc = correlation_type,
    corOptions = list(maxPOutliers = max_p_outliers),
    verbose = 0
  )

  soft_tbl <- tibble::as_tibble(sft$fitIndices) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      network_label = network_label,
      requested_gene_n = requested_gene_n,
      retained_gene_n = ncol(dat_expr),
      power = .data$Power,
      scale_free_fit = .data$SFT.R.sq,
      slope = .data$slope,
      mean_connectivity = .data$mean.k.,
      median_connectivity = .data$median.k.,
      max_connectivity = .data$max.k.
    )

  power_decision <- select_soft_power(
    soft_tbl,
    target = soft_threshold_target
  )
  selected_power <- power_decision$power

  net <- WGCNA::blockwiseModules(
    dat_expr,
    power = selected_power,
    networkType = network_type,
    TOMType = network_type,
    corType = correlation_type,
    maxPOutliers = max_p_outliers,
    minModuleSize = minimum_module_size,
    mergeCutHeight = merge_cut_height,
    deepSplit = deep_split,
    numericLabels = FALSE,
    pamRespectsDendro = pam_respects_dendro,
    maxBlockSize = min(max_block_size, ncol(dat_expr)),
    saveTOMs = FALSE,
    verbose = 0
  )

  raw_module_colors <- as.character(net$colors)
  names(raw_module_colors) <- colnames(dat_expr)
  corrected_modules <- wgcna_correct_undersized_modules(
    raw_module_colors,
    minimum_module_size
  )
  module_colors <- corrected_modules$colors
  oriented_modules <- wgcna_orient_eigengenes(
    dat_expr,
    module_colors,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
  )
  module_eigengenes <- oriented_modules$eigengenes

  module_assignment <- tibble::tibble(
    network_label = network_label,
    network_size = requested_gene_n,
    gene_id = names(module_colors),
    module = unname(module_colors),
    module_label = paste0("ME", unname(module_colors))
  )

  kme_tbl <- tibble::as_tibble(
    WGCNA::signedKME(
      dat_expr,
      module_eigengenes,
      outputColumnName = "kME",
      corFnc = correlation_type,
      corOptions = paste0(
        "maxPOutliers = ",
        max_p_outliers
      )
    ),
    rownames = "gene_id"
  )

  module_assignment$module_kME_signed <- NA_real_
  for (current_module in unique(module_assignment$module)) {
    kme_column <- paste0("kME", current_module)
    current_rows <- module_assignment$module == current_module
    if (kme_column %in% names(kme_tbl)) {
      module_assignment$module_kME_signed[current_rows] <-
        kme_tbl[[kme_column]][
          match(
            module_assignment$gene_id[current_rows],
            kme_tbl$gene_id
          )
        ]
    }
  }

  module_assignment <- module_assignment %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      module_kME_abs = abs(.data$module_kME_signed)
    )

  module_summary <- module_assignment %>%
    dplyr::count(
      .data$network_label,
      .data$network_size,
      .data$module,
      .data$module_label,
      name = "n_genes"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      module_type = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$module == "grey",
        "unassigned",
        "assigned"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data$module_type,
      dplyr::desc(.data$n_genes)
    )

  assigned_module_sizes_for_assertion <- module_summary$n_genes[
    module_summary$module != "grey"
  ]
  if (length(assigned_module_sizes_for_assertion) > 0L &&
      any(assigned_module_sizes_for_assertion < minimum_module_size)) {
    stop(network_label, " retained an assigned module below minModuleSize.")
  }
  module_labels_from_colors <- paste0("ME", sort(unique(module_colors)))
  module_labels_from_mes <- names(module_eigengenes)
  if (!setequal(module_labels_from_colors, module_labels_from_mes)) {
    stop(network_label, " module-colour and eigengene labels do not match.")
  }

  eigengene_tbl <- tibble::as_tibble(
    module_eigengenes,
    rownames = "sample_code"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      metadata_network %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$sample_code,
          .data$site_id,
          .data$station_tag,
          dplyr::any_of(c(
            "display_label",
            "site_name",
            "station_order"
          ))
        ),
      by = "sample_code"
    )

  contrast_tbl <- fit_planned_module_contrasts(
    eigengene_tbl = eigengene_tbl,
    metadata_tbl = metadata_network,
    network_label = network_label,
    network_size = requested_gene_n,
    module_assignment = module_assignment,
    contrast_tbl = planned_contrasts
  )

  selected_soft_row <- power_decision$row

  assigned_sizes <- module_summary$n_genes[
    module_summary$module_type == "assigned"
  ]
  grey_n <- sum(
    module_summary$n_genes[module_summary$module == "grey"],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  assigned_n <- ncol(dat_expr) - grey_n

  network_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    network_label = network_label,
    requested_gene_n = requested_gene_n,
    retained_gene_n = ncol(dat_expr),
    retained_sample_n = nrow(dat_expr),
    selected_power = selected_power,
    selected_power_rule = power_decision$rule,
    selected_scale_free_fit = selected_soft_row$scale_free_fit[[1]],
    selected_slope = selected_soft_row$slope[[1]],
    selected_mean_connectivity =
      selected_soft_row$mean_connectivity[[1]],
    selected_median_connectivity =
      selected_soft_row$median_connectivity[[1]],
    target_reached =
      selected_soft_row$scale_free_fit[[1]] >= soft_threshold_target,
    reference_power_scale_free_fit = soft_tbl$scale_free_fit[
      match(reference_power_for_comparison, soft_tbl$power)
    ],
    reference_power_mean_connectivity = soft_tbl$mean_connectivity[
      match(reference_power_for_comparison, soft_tbl$power)
    ],
    n_assigned_modules = sum(
      module_summary$module_type == "assigned"
    ),
    n_assigned_genes = assigned_n,
    assigned_gene_fraction = assigned_n / ncol(dat_expr),
    n_grey_genes = grey_n,
    grey_gene_fraction = grey_n / ncol(dat_expr),
    median_assigned_module_size = if (
      length(assigned_sizes) > 0L
    ) stats::median(assigned_sizes) else NA_real_,
    minimum_assigned_module_size = if (
      length(assigned_sizes) > 0L
    ) min(assigned_sizes) else NA_real_,
    maximum_assigned_module_size = if (
      length(assigned_sizes) > 0L
    ) max(assigned_sizes) else NA_real_,
    n_blocks = length(net$blockGenes),
    max_block_size_setting = min(max_block_size, ncol(dat_expr)),
    n_fdr_supported_contrasts = sum(
      contrast_tbl$fdr_supported,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_large_nominal_contrasts = sum(
      contrast_tbl$large_nominal_effect,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  write_csv_safe(
    soft_tbl,
    file.path(
      tables_dir,
      paste0(network_label, "_soft_threshold_diagnostics.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    module_summary,
    file.path(
      tables_dir,
      paste0(network_label, "_module_summary.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    oriented_modules$orientation,
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(network_label, "_eigengene_orientation.csv"))
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    tibble::tibble(
      raw_module = names(corrected_modules$raw_sizes),
      raw_module_size = as.integer(corrected_modules$raw_sizes)
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        below_declared_minimum =
          .data$raw_module != "grey" &
          .data$raw_module_size < minimum_module_size,
        final_action = dplyr::if_else(
          .data$below_declared_minimum,
          "reclassified_to_exact_grey_before_testing",
          "retained"
        )
      ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(network_label, "_module_identity_audit.csv"))
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    module_assignment,
    file.path(
      tables_dir,
      paste0(network_label, "_gene_module_membership.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    eigengene_tbl,
    file.path(
      tables_dir,
      paste0(network_label, "_module_eigengenes_by_sample.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    contrast_tbl,
    file.path(
      tables_dir,
      paste0(network_label, "_planned_module_contrasts.csv")
    )
  )

  rm(net, dat_expr, kme_tbl)
  invisible(gc())

  list(
    network_label = network_label,
    network_size = requested_gene_n,
    selected_gene_ids = selected_gene_ids,
    soft = soft_tbl,
    summary = network_summary,
    modules = module_summary,
    assignment = module_assignment,
    eigengenes = eigengene_tbl,
    orientation = oriented_modules$orientation,
    raw_undersized_modules = corrected_modules$undersized_modules,
    contrasts = contrast_tbl
  )
}

load_or_run_network_for_gene_set <- function(
  requested_gene_n,
  ranked_gene_ids,
  expression_matrix,
  metadata_aligned,
  input_signature
) {
  network_label <- paste0("G", requested_gene_n)
  selected_ids <- utils::head(
    ranked_gene_ids,
    min(requested_gene_n, length(ranked_gene_ids))
  )
  cache_signature <- paste(
    input_signature,
    paste0("network_label=", network_label),
    paste0(
      "selected_gene_hash=",
      digest::digest(selected_ids, algo = "xxhash64")
    ),
    paste0("WGCNA=", as.character(utils::packageVersion("WGCNA"))),
    paste0("powers=", paste(candidate_powers, collapse = ";")),
    paste0("target=", soft_threshold_target),
    paste0("network_type=", network_type),
    paste0("correlation_type=", correlation_type),
    paste0("max_p_outliers=", max_p_outliers),
    paste0("minimum_module_size=", minimum_module_size),
    paste0("merge_cut_height=", merge_cut_height),
    paste0("deep_split=", deep_split),
    paste0("pam_respects_dendro=", pam_respects_dendro),
    paste0("max_block_size=", max_block_size),
    "finalisation_validation=v2",
    sep = "||"
  )
  cache_file <- file.path(
    objects_dir,
    paste0(network_label, "_network_result_cache.rds")
  )

  if (reuse_network_cache && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    if (
      is.list(cached) &&
        identical(cached$cache_signature, cache_signature) &&
        is.list(cached$result)
    ) {
      message("Reusing validated cache for ", network_label)
      result <- cached$result
      result$contrasts <- fit_planned_module_contrasts(
        eigengene_tbl = result$eigengenes,
        metadata_tbl = metadata_aligned,
        network_label = result$network_label,
        network_size = result$network_size,
        module_assignment = result$assignment,
        contrast_tbl = planned_contrasts
      )
      result$summary <- result$summary %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          n_fdr_supported_contrasts = sum(
            result$contrasts$fdr_supported,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          n_large_nominal_contrasts = sum(
            result$contrasts$large_nominal_effect,
            na.rm = TRUE
          )
        )
      write_csv_safe(
        result$contrasts,
        file.path(
          tables_dir,
          paste0(network_label, "_planned_module_contrasts.csv")
        )
      )
      cached$result <- result
      saveRDS(cached, cache_file, compress = FALSE)
      return(result)
    }
  }

  result <- run_network_for_gene_set(
    requested_gene_n = requested_gene_n,
    ranked_gene_ids = ranked_gene_ids,
    expression_matrix = expression_matrix,
    metadata_aligned = metadata_aligned
  )
  saveRDS(
    list(cache_signature = cache_signature, result = result),
    cache_file,
    compress = FALSE
  )
  result
}

compare_network_pair <- function(reference_result, test_result) {
  reference_label <- reference_result$network_label
  test_label <- test_result$network_label

  reference_assignment <- reference_result$assignment %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene_id,
      reference_module = module,
      reference_module_label = module_label
    )
  test_assignment <- test_result$assignment %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene_id,
      test_module = module,
      test_module_label = module_label
    )

  shared_assignment <- reference_assignment %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(test_assignment, by = "gene_id")

  reference_modules <- shared_assignment %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$reference_module != "grey") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$reference_module,
      .data$reference_module_label
    )

  test_assigned_modules <- shared_assignment %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$test_module != "grey") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data$test_module,
      .data$test_module_label
    )

  reference_eigengenes <- reference_result$eigengenes
  test_eigengenes <- test_result$eigengenes

  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    reference_modules,
    function(reference_module, reference_module_label) {
      reference_gene_set <- shared_assignment$gene_id[
        shared_assignment$reference_module == reference_module
      ]
      reference_to_grey_n <- sum(
        shared_assignment$reference_module == reference_module &
          shared_assignment$test_module == "grey"
      )

      candidate_matches <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
        test_assigned_modules,
        function(test_module, test_module_label) {
          test_gene_set <- shared_assignment$gene_id[
            shared_assignment$test_module == test_module
          ]
          intersection_n <- length(intersect(
            reference_gene_set,
            test_gene_set
          ))
          union_n <- length(union(
            reference_gene_set,
            test_gene_set
          ))

          tibble::tibble(
            test_module = test_module,
            test_module_label = test_module_label,
            intersection_n = intersection_n,
            union_n = union_n,
            jaccard = if (
              union_n > 0L
            ) intersection_n / union_n else NA_real_,
            reference_recovery_fraction = if (
              length(reference_gene_set) > 0L
            ) intersection_n / length(reference_gene_set) else NA_real_,
            test_purity_fraction = if (
              length(test_gene_set) > 0L
            ) intersection_n / length(test_gene_set) else NA_real_
          )
        }
      ) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(
          dplyr::desc(.data$jaccard),
          dplyr::desc(.data$intersection_n)
        )

      best_match <- candidate_matches %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

      if (nrow(best_match) == 0L) {
        return(tibble::tibble(
          reference_network = reference_label,
          test_network = test_label,
          reference_size = reference_result$network_size,
          test_size = test_result$network_size,
          reference_module = reference_module,
          reference_module_label = reference_module_label,
          test_module = NA_character_,
          test_module_label = NA_character_,
          reference_module_shared_n = length(reference_gene_set),
          reference_to_test_grey_n = reference_to_grey_n,
          reference_to_test_grey_fraction = safe_divide(
            reference_to_grey_n,
            length(reference_gene_set)
          ),
          intersection_n = 0L,
          union_n = NA_integer_,
          jaccard = NA_real_,
          reference_recovery_fraction = NA_real_,
          test_purity_fraction = NA_real_,
          eigengene_profile_cor = NA_real_,
          eigengene_profile_abs_cor = NA_real_,
          preservation_class = "not_matched"
        ))
      }

      test_module_label <- best_match$test_module_label[[1]]
      profile_cor <- NA_real_
      if (
        reference_module_label %in% names(reference_eigengenes) &&
          test_module_label %in% names(test_eigengenes)
      ) {
        profile_pair <- reference_eigengenes %>%
          dplyr::transmute(
            sample_code = .data$sample_code,
            reference_value = .data[[reference_module_label]]
          ) %>%
          dplyr::inner_join(
            test_eigengenes %>%
              dplyr::transmute(
                sample_code = .data$sample_code,
                test_value = .data[[test_module_label]]
              ),
            by = "sample_code"
          )

        profile_cor <- WGCNA::bicor(
          profile_pair$reference_value,
          profile_pair$test_value,
          use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
          maxPOutliers = max_p_outliers
        ) %>%
          as.numeric() %>%
          first()
      }

      preservation_class <- dplyr::case_when(
        is.finite(best_match$jaccard[[1]]) &&
          best_match$jaccard[[1]] >= 0.60 &&
          is.finite(profile_cor) &&
          abs(profile_cor) >= 0.75 ~ "high",
        is.finite(best_match$jaccard[[1]]) &&
          best_match$jaccard[[1]] >= 0.40 &&
          is.finite(profile_cor) &&
          abs(profile_cor) >= 0.60 ~ "moderate",
        TRUE ~ "low"
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        reference_network = reference_label,
        test_network = test_label,
        reference_size = reference_result$network_size,
        test_size = test_result$network_size,
        reference_module = reference_module,
        reference_module_label = reference_module_label,
        test_module = best_match$test_module[[1]],
        test_module_label = test_module_label,
        reference_module_shared_n = length(reference_gene_set),
        reference_to_test_grey_n = reference_to_grey_n,
        reference_to_test_grey_fraction = safe_divide(
          reference_to_grey_n,
          length(reference_gene_set)
        ),
        intersection_n = best_match$intersection_n[[1]],
        union_n = best_match$union_n[[1]],
        jaccard = best_match$jaccard[[1]],
        reference_recovery_fraction =
          best_match$reference_recovery_fraction[[1]],
        test_purity_fraction = best_match$test_purity_fraction[[1]],
        eigengene_profile_cor = profile_cor,
        eigengene_profile_abs_cor = abs(profile_cor),
        preservation_class = preservation_class
      )
    }
  )
}
```

# 2. Load and rank the expression matrix

Genes are ranked once by variance across all 30 VST libraries. The 5,000-,
10,000-, and 15,000-gene networks are therefore nested and differ only by the
number of lower-ranked genes admitted to the network. Site labels are not used
for feature selection.

```{r load-and-rank-expression}
station_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
  station_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
metadata_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
  metadata_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_code = as.character(.data$sample_code),
    site_id = as.character(.data$site_id),
    station_tag = as.character(.data$station_tag)
  )

vst_tbl <- readr::read_tsv(
  vst_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

sample_columns <- intersect(
  metadata_tbl$sample_code,
  setdiff(names(vst_tbl), "gene_id")
)

if (length(sample_columns) != nrow(metadata_tbl)) {
  stop(
    "Sample mismatch: ",
    length(sample_columns),
    " VST columns versus ",
    nrow(metadata_tbl),
    " metadata rows."
  )
}

metadata_aligned <- metadata_tbl %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(sample_columns, .data$sample_code)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    station_tbl %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$legacy_site_id,
        dplyr::any_of(c(
          "station_order",
          "chemistry_series_order",
          "site_context",
          "chemistry_status"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("site_id" = "legacy_site_id")
  )

expression_tbl <- vst_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$gene_id,
    dplyr::all_of(sample_columns)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  expression_tbl[, sample_columns]
)
rownames(expression_matrix) <- expression_tbl$gene_id
storage.mode(expression_matrix) <- "double"

gene_variance <- matrixStats::rowVars(
  expression_matrix,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
names(gene_variance) <- rownames(expression_matrix)

valid_gene <- is.finite(gene_variance) & gene_variance > 0
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[valid_gene, , drop = FALSE]
gene_variance <- gene_variance[valid_gene]
ranked_gene_ids <- names(
  sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE)
)

if (length(ranked_gene_ids) < min(gene_set_sizes)) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than ",
    min(gene_set_sizes),
    " non-zero-variance genes are available."
  )
}

available_gene_set_sizes <- gene_set_sizes[
  gene_set_sizes <= length(ranked_gene_ids)
]
if (length(available_gene_set_sizes) == 0L) {
  stop("None of the requested gene-set sizes can be constructed.")
}
if (!all(gene_set_sizes %in% available_gene_set_sizes)) {
  warning(
    "Requested sizes exceeding the available non-zero-variance genes were skipped."
  )
}
gene_set_sizes <- available_gene_set_sizes

network_input_info <- file.info(c(vst_file, metadata_file, station_file))
network_input_signature <- paste(
  paste(
    basename(rownames(network_input_info)),
    network_input_info$size,
    as.character(unname(tools::md5sum(rownames(network_input_info)))),
    paste0("samples=", paste(sample_columns, collapse = ";"))
  ),
  collapse = "||"
)

expression_qc <- tibble::tibble(
  raw_vst_gene_n = nrow(vst_tbl),
  unique_gene_n = nrow(expression_tbl),
  nonzero_variance_gene_n = length(ranked_gene_ids),
  sample_n = length(sample_columns),
  tested_gene_sets = paste(gene_set_sizes, collapse = " | "),
  maximum_block_size = max_block_size
)

write_csv_safe(
  expression_qc,
  file.path(tables_dir, "expression_input_qc.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = ranked_gene_ids,
    variance_rank = seq_along(ranked_gene_ids),
    vst_variance = unname(gene_variance[ranked_gene_ids])
  ),
  file.path(tables_dir, "vst_gene_variance_ranking.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  expression_qc,
  caption = "Expression input and sensitivity-design summary."
)
```

# 3. Reconstruct the networks

Each network uses the same signed biweight-midcorrelation design. The
soft-thresholding power is selected independently using the current Step 02 rule:
the lowest tested power reaching the target is retained; when the target is not
reached, the power with the highest available fit is used. Diagnostics at power
12 are also retained so that the effect of adding genes can be compared at a
common power.

```{r reconstruct-networks, message=TRUE}
network_results <- purrr::map(
  gene_set_sizes,
  load_or_run_network_for_gene_set,
  ranked_gene_ids = ranked_gene_ids,
  expression_matrix = expression_matrix,
  metadata_aligned = metadata_aligned,
  input_signature = network_input_signature
)
names(network_results) <- vapply(
  network_results,
  function(current_result) current_result$network_label,
  character(1)
)

network_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  "summary"
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$requested_gene_n)

soft_threshold_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  "soft"
)
module_summary_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  "modules"
)
module_assignment_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  "assignment"
)
planned_contrasts_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  "contrasts"
)

write_csv_safe(
  network_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "network_size_diagnostic_summary.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  soft_threshold_all,
  file.path(tables_dir, "soft_threshold_diagnostics_all_gene_sets.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  module_summary_all,
  file.path(tables_dir, "module_summary_all_gene_sets.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  planned_contrasts_all,
  file.path(tables_dir, "planned_module_contrasts_all_gene_sets.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  network_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "WGCNA diagnostics across the tested gene-set sizes."
)
```

# 5. Preservation of modules across nested gene sets

Reference modules are matched to modules in the larger network after restricting
both assignments to their shared genes. Jaccard similarity measures overlap in
gene membership. Eigengene-profile correlation measures whether the matched
modules retain the same dominant expression pattern across the 30 libraries;
its absolute value is reported because eigengene signs are arbitrary. The
high/moderate/low classes are transparent heuristics for screening and are not
formal WGCNA preservation statistics.

```{r module-preservation-across-sizes}
network_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~reference_size, ~test_size,
  5000L, 10000L,
  5000L, 15000L,
  10000L, 15000L
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$reference_size %in% gene_set_sizes,
    .data$test_size %in% gene_set_sizes
  )

module_preservation <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  network_pairs,
  function(reference_size, test_size) {
    reference_result <- network_results[[
      paste0("G", reference_size)
    ]]
    test_result <- network_results[[
      paste0("G", test_size)
    ]]

    compare_network_pair(
      reference_result,
      test_result
    )
  }
)

preservation_summary <- module_preservation %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$reference_network,
    .data$test_network,
    .data$reference_size,
    .data$test_size
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_reference_modules = dplyr::n(),
    median_jaccard = stats::median(
      .data$jaccard,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_jaccard = min(
      .data$jaccard,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_reference_recovery = stats::median(
      .data$reference_recovery_fraction,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_abs_eigengene_cor = stats::median(
      .data$eigengene_profile_abs_cor,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_high_preservation = sum(
      .data$preservation_class == "high",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_moderate_preservation = sum(
      .data$preservation_class == "moderate",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_low_preservation = sum(
      .data$preservation_class == "low",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv_safe(
  module_preservation,
  file.path(tables_dir, "module_preservation_across_gene_sets.csv")
```

# 6. Preservation of planned site-contrast signals

The three planned contrasts are fitted separately within each reconstructed
network using the individual-library module eigengenes. Benjamini-Hochberg
correction is applied across all module-by-contrast tests within each network.
Because module labels and eigengene signs are arbitrary across networks, direct
cross-network effect comparisons are made only for the best-matched modules and
the test-network effect is aligned to the sign of the eigengene-profile
correlation.

```{r contrast-preservation}
contrast_preservation <- module_preservation %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$test_module_label)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$reference_network,
    .data$test_network,
    .data$reference_size,
    .data$test_size,
    .data$reference_module_label,
    .data$test_module_label,
    .data$jaccard,
    .data$eigengene_profile_cor,
    .data$eigengene_profile_abs_cor,
    .data$preservation_class
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    planned_contrasts_all %>%
      dplyr::select(
        reference_network = .data$network_label,
        reference_module_label = .data$module_label,
        .data$contrast,
        .data$contrast_panel,
        reference_hedges_g = .data$hedges_g,
        reference_p = .data$p_value,
        reference_q = .data$q_global_network,
        reference_fdr_supported = .data$fdr_supported,
        reference_large_nominal = .data$large_nominal_effect
      ),
    by = c(
      "reference_network",
      "reference_module_label"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    planned_contrasts_all %>%
      dplyr::select(
        test_network = .data$network_label,
        test_module_label = .data$module_label,
        .data$contrast,
        test_hedges_g = .data$hedges_g,
        test_p = .data$p_value,
        test_q = .data$q_global_network,
        test_fdr_supported = .data$fdr_supported,
        test_large_nominal = .data$large_nominal_effect
      ),
    by = c(
      "test_network",
      "test_module_label",
      "contrast"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    alignment_sign = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(.data$eigengene_profile_cor) &
        .data$eigengene_profile_cor < 0,
      -1,
      1
    ),
    test_hedges_g_aligned =
      .data$test_hedges_g * .data$alignment_sign,
    aligned_effect_difference =
      .data$test_hedges_g_aligned - .data$reference_hedges_g,
    same_aligned_direction = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.finite(.data$reference_hedges_g) |
        !is.finite(.data$test_hedges_g_aligned) ~ NA,
      .data$reference_hedges_g == 0 |
        .data$test_hedges_g_aligned == 0 ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ sign(.data$reference_hedges_g) ==
        sign(.data$test_hedges_g_aligned)
    )
  )

contrast_network_summary <- planned_contrasts_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    .data$network_label,
    .data$network_size,
    .data$contrast,
    .data$contrast_panel
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_tested_modules = dplyr::n(),
    n_fdr_supported = sum(
      .data$fdr_supported,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_large_nominal = sum(
      .data$large_nominal_effect,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    maximum_abs_hedges_g = max(
      abs(.data$hedges_g),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_global_q = min(
      .data$q_global_network,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    leading_module = .data$module_label[
      which.max(abs(.data$hedges_g))
    ][[1]],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv_safe(
  contrast_preservation,
  file.path(tables_dir, "planned_contrast_preservation_across_gene_sets.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  contrast_network_summary,
  file.path(tables_dir, "planned_contrast_summary_by_gene_set.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  contrast_network_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Planned module-contrast evidence across gene-set sizes."
)
```

# 7. DEG and annotation coverage

Increasing the gene set can improve biological coverage even when the
scale-free-topology fit does not improve. This section records how many focal
DEGs, annotated genes, and GO-mapped genes are eligible for the network and how
many are retained in assigned modules. These diagnostics do not use DEG status
or annotation to construct the network.

```{r load-deg-and-annotation-coverage}
focal_deg_objects <- purrr::pmap(
  deg_source_tbl,
  function(contrast, numerator_site, denominator_site, path) {
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      stop("Required DEG file is missing for ", contrast, ": ", path)
    }
    raw_tbl <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    required_columns <- c(
      "gene_id", "contrast", "numerator", "denominator", "padj",
      "log2FoldChange_shrunk"
    )
    missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(raw_tbl))
    if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
      stop(
        "DEG file for ", contrast, " is missing: ",
        paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    observed_contrasts <- unique(as.character(raw_tbl$contrast))
    observed_numerators <- unique(as.character(raw_tbl$numerator))
    observed_denominators <- unique(as.character(raw_tbl$denominator))
    if (!identical(observed_contrasts, contrast) ||
        !identical(observed_numerators, numerator_site) ||
        !identical(observed_denominators, denominator_site)) {
      stop(
        "DEG direction audit failed for ", contrast,
        ". Expected ", numerator_site, " versus ", denominator_site, "."
      )
    }

    filtered_tbl <- raw_tbl %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        is.finite(.data$padj),
        .data$padj < 0.05,
        is.finite(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
        abs(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= 1
      ) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        gene_id = as.character(.data$gene_id),
        contrast = as.character(.data$contrast),
        numerator = as.character(.data$numerator),
        denominator = as.character(.data$denominator),
        padj = as.numeric(.data$padj),
        log2FoldChange_shrunk = as.numeric(.data$log2FoldChange_shrunk),
        direction = dplyr::if_else(
          .data$log2FoldChange_shrunk > 0,
          "higher_in_numerator",
          "lower_in_numerator"
        ),
        source_file = normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(.data$gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

    list(
      genes = filtered_tbl,
      audit = tibble::tibble(
        contrast = contrast,
        numerator = numerator_site,
        denominator = denominator_site,
        source_file = normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
        input_row_n = nrow(raw_tbl),
        padj_lt_0_05_n = sum(
          is.finite(raw_tbl$padj) & raw_tbl$padj < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        abs_shrunken_log2fc_ge_1_n = sum(
          is.finite(raw_tbl$log2FoldChange_shrunk) &
            abs(raw_tbl$log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        final_deg_n = nrow(filtered_tbl),
        criteria = "padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FoldChange_shrunk) >= 1"
      )
    )
  }
)

focal_deg_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(focal_deg_objects, "genes")
deg_input_audit <- purrr::map_dfr(focal_deg_objects, "audit")

missing_contrasts <- setdiff(
  planned_contrasts$contrast,

)
if (length(missing_contrasts) > 0L) {

}
if (deg_input_audit$final_deg_n[
      deg_input_audit$contrast == "HOL05_vs_HOL04"
    ] == 0L) {
  stop("H6-H5 DEG loading returned zero genes after the declared filters.")
}

write_csv_safe(

  file.path(tables_dir, "focal_deg_input_audit.csv")

annotation_gene_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  gene_id = character(),
  has_readable_annotation = logical()
)

if (file.exists(annotation_file)) {
  raw_annotation_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
    annotation_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  if ("gene_id" %in% names(raw_annotation_tbl)) {
    candidate_annotation_columns <- intersect(
      c(
        "best_gene_label",
        "gene_label",
        "EggNM.Preferred_name",
        "EggNM.Description",
        "consensus_gene_symbol",
        "annotation"
      ),
      names(raw_annotation_tbl)
    )

    if (length(candidate_annotation_columns) > 0L) {
      annotation_values <- dplyr::select(
        raw_annotation_tbl,
        dplyr::all_of(candidate_annotation_columns)
      )
      annotation_gene_ids <- as.character(raw_annotation_tbl$gene_id)
      has_readable_annotation <- vapply(
        seq_len(nrow(raw_annotation_tbl)),
        function(row_index) {
          current_values <- safe_chr(
            unlist(annotation_values[row_index, ], use.names = FALSE)
          )
          current_values <- current_values[
            !is.na(current_values) &
              !current_values %in% c("NA", ".", "-") &
              current_values != annotation_gene_ids[[row_index]] &
              !stringr::str_detect(current_values, "^TRINITY_")
          ]
          length(current_values) > 0L
        },
        logical(1)
      )

      annotation_gene_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
        gene_id = annotation_gene_ids,
        has_readable_annotation = has_readable_annotation
      ) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(.data$gene_id) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          has_readable_annotation = any(
            .data$has_readable_annotation,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }
  }
}

go_gene_ids <- character()
if (file.exists(gene_to_go_file)) {
  gene_to_go_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
    gene_to_go_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  if ("gene_id" %in% names(gene_to_go_tbl)) {
    go_gene_ids <- unique(as.character(gene_to_go_tbl$gene_id))
  }
}

network_gene_coverage <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  function(current_result) {
    current_assignment <- current_result$assignment
    eligible_gene_ids <- unique(current_assignment$gene_id)
    assigned_gene_ids <- unique(
      current_assignment$gene_id[
        current_assignment$module != "grey"
      ]
    )

    annotated_gene_ids <- annotation_gene_tbl$gene_id[
      annotation_gene_tbl$has_readable_annotation
    ]

    tibble::tibble(
      network_label = current_result$network_label,
      network_size = current_result$network_size,
      eligible_gene_n = length(eligible_gene_ids),
      assigned_gene_n = length(assigned_gene_ids),
      readable_annotation_eligible_n = length(intersect(
        eligible_gene_ids,
        annotated_gene_ids
      )),
      readable_annotation_assigned_n = length(intersect(
        assigned_gene_ids,
        annotated_gene_ids
      )),
      go_mapped_eligible_n = length(intersect(
        eligible_gene_ids,
        go_gene_ids
      )),
      go_mapped_assigned_n = length(intersect(
        assigned_gene_ids,
        go_gene_ids
      ))
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        readable_annotation_eligible_fraction = safe_divide(
          .data$readable_annotation_eligible_n,
          .data$eligible_gene_n
        ),
        readable_annotation_assigned_fraction = safe_divide(
          .data$readable_annotation_assigned_n,
          .data$assigned_gene_n
        ),
        go_mapped_eligible_fraction = safe_divide(
          .data$go_mapped_eligible_n,
          .data$eligible_gene_n
        ),
        go_mapped_assigned_fraction = safe_divide(
          .data$go_mapped_assigned_n,
          .data$assigned_gene_n
        )
      )
  }
)

deg_coverage <- purrr::map_dfr(
  network_results,
  function(current_result) {
    current_assignment <- current_result$assignment
    eligible_gene_ids <- unique(current_assignment$gene_id)
    assigned_gene_ids <- unique(
      current_assignment$gene_id[
        current_assignment$module != "grey"
      ]
    )

    planned_contrasts %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .data$contrast,
        .data$contrast_panel
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        network_label = current_result$network_label,
        network_size = current_result$network_size,
        total_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(
          .data$contrast,
          function(current_contrast) {
            dplyr::n_distinct(
              focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[
                focal_deg_tbl$contrast == current_contrast
              ]
            )
          }
        ),
        eligible_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(
          .data$contrast,
          function(current_contrast) {
            current_degs <- focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[
              focal_deg_tbl$contrast == current_contrast
            ]
            length(intersect(current_degs, eligible_gene_ids))
          }
        ),
        assigned_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(
          .data$contrast,
          function(current_contrast) {
            current_degs <- focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[
              focal_deg_tbl$contrast == current_contrast
            ]
            length(intersect(current_degs, assigned_gene_ids))
          }
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        eligible_deg_fraction = safe_divide(
          .data$eligible_significant_deg_n,
          .data$total_significant_deg_n
        ),
        assigned_deg_fraction_of_total = safe_divide(
          .data$assigned_significant_deg_n,
          .data$total_significant_deg_n
        ),
        assigned_deg_fraction_of_eligible = safe_divide(
          .data$assigned_significant_deg_n,
          .data$eligible_significant_deg_n
        )
      )
  }
)
```

# 8. Structural power sensitivity for the 10,000-gene candidate

The 10,000-gene candidate is reconstructed at powers 12, 14, 16, 18, and 20
with every other network setting fixed. Selection uses connectivity, module
assignment, adjacent-power preservation, and site-stratified resampling only.
Site contrasts, DEG overlap, enrichment yield, and chemistry are not available
to the power-selection rule.

```{r ten-thousand-power-sensitivity, message=TRUE}
g10000_gene_ids <- utils::head(ranked_gene_ids, 10000L)
dat_expr_g10000 <- t(
  expression_matrix[g10000_gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
)
rownames(dat_expr_g10000) <- metadata_aligned$sample_code

g10000_soft_tbl <- network_results$G10000$soft %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$power %in% power_sensitivity_candidates)

connectivity_cache_signature <- paste(
  network_input_signature,
  paste0("gene_hash=", digest::digest(g10000_gene_ids, algo = "xxhash64")),
  paste0("powers=", paste(power_sensitivity_candidates, collapse = ";")),
  paste0("network_type=", network_type),
  paste0("correlation_type=", correlation_type),
  paste0("max_p_outliers=", max_p_outliers),
  paste0("very_low_threshold=", very_low_connectivity_threshold),
  sep = "||"
)
connectivity_cache_file <- file.path(
  objects_dir,
  paste0(
    "power_connectivity_distribution_",
    digest::digest(connectivity_cache_signature, algo = "xxhash64"),
    ".rds"
  )
)
if (reuse_power_sensitivity_cache && file.exists(connectivity_cache_file)) {
  cached_connectivity <- readRDS(connectivity_cache_file)
  if (is.list(cached_connectivity) &&
      identical(cached_connectivity$signature, connectivity_cache_signature)) {
    power_connectivity_distribution <- cached_connectivity$result
  }
}
if (!exists("power_connectivity_distribution", inherits = FALSE)) {
  power_connectivity_distribution <- purrr::map_dfr(
    power_sensitivity_candidates,
    function(current_power) {
      message("Calculating connectivity distribution at power ", current_power)
      connectivity <- WGCNA::softConnectivity(
        dat_expr_g10000,
        corFnc = correlation_type,
        corOptions = paste0(
          "use = 'p', maxPOutliers = ", max_p_outliers
        ),
        type = network_type,
        power = current_power,
        blockSize = 1000,
        verbose = 0
      )
      tibble::tibble(
        power = current_power,
        connectivity_p10 = unname(stats::quantile(
          connectivity, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE
        )),
        connectivity_p90 = unname(stats::quantile(
          connectivity, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE
        )),
        proportion_very_low_connectivity = mean(
          connectivity < very_low_connectivity_threshold,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        very_low_connectivity_threshold = very_low_connectivity_threshold
      )
    }
  )
  saveRDS(
    list(
      signature = connectivity_cache_signature,
      result = power_connectivity_distribution
    ),
    connectivity_cache_file,
    compress = FALSE
  )
}

power_cache_signature_base <- paste(
  network_input_signature,
  paste0(
    "gene_hash=",
    digest::digest(g10000_gene_ids, algo = "xxhash64")
  ),
  paste0("WGCNA=", as.character(utils::packageVersion("WGCNA"))),
  paste0("seed=", power_sensitivity_seed),
  paste0("network_type=", network_type),
  paste0("correlation_type=", correlation_type),
  paste0("max_p_outliers=", max_p_outliers),
  paste0("minimum_module_size=", minimum_module_size),
  paste0("merge_cut_height=", merge_cut_height),
  paste0("deep_split=", deep_split),
  paste0("pam_respects_dendro=", pam_respects_dendro),
  paste0("max_block_size=", max_block_size),
  "undersized_module_policy=reclassify_to_exact_grey_v1",
  "eigengene_orientation=positive_average_standardized_expression_v1",
  sep = "||"
)

power_network_cache_dir <- file.path(
  objects_dir, "power_sensitivity_network_cache"
)
power_resample_cache_dir <- file.path(
  objects_dir, "power_sensitivity_resample_cache"
)
dir.create(power_network_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(power_resample_cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

load_or_run_power_network <- function(current_power) {
  current_signature <- paste(
    power_cache_signature_base,
    paste0("power=", current_power),
    sep = "||"
  )
  cache_file <- file.path(
    power_network_cache_dir,
    paste0(
      "G10000_power_", current_power, "_",
      digest::digest(current_signature, algo = "xxhash64"),
      ".rds"
    )
  )
  if (reuse_power_sensitivity_cache && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    if (is.list(cached) &&
        identical(cached$signature, current_signature)) {
      message("Reusing 10,000-gene power cache: ", current_power)
      return(cached$result)
    }
  }
  set.seed(power_sensitivity_seed + current_power)
  result <- wgcna_run_validated_network(
    dat_expr = dat_expr_g10000,
    power = current_power,
    network_type = network_type,
    correlation_type = correlation_type,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers,
    minimum_module_size = minimum_module_size,
    merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
    deep_split = deep_split,
    pam_respects_dendro = pam_respects_dendro,
    max_block_size = max_block_size,
    verbose = 0
  )
  saveRDS(
    list(signature = current_signature, result = result),
    cache_file,
    compress = FALSE
  )
  result
}

power_network_results <- purrr::map(
  power_sensitivity_candidates,
  load_or_run_power_network
)
names(power_network_results) <- paste0("P", power_sensitivity_candidates)

power_module_audit <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  power_network_results,
  function(current_result, current_label) {
    current_result$module_audit %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        power = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(current_label, "^P")),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)
power_anomalous_gene_audit <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  power_network_results,
  function(current_result, current_label) {
    current_result$anomalous_gene_audit %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        power = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(current_label, "^P")),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)
power_eigengene_orientation <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  power_network_results,
  function(current_result, current_label) {
    current_result$orientation %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        power = as.integer(stringr::str_remove(current_label, "^P")),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

power_network_structure <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  power_network_results,
  function(current_result, current_label) {
    current_power <- as.integer(stringr::str_remove(current_label, "^P"))
    assigned_sizes <- current_result$module_summary$n_genes[
      current_result$module_summary$module != "grey"
    ]
    grey_n <- sum(current_result$module_summary$n_genes[
      current_result$module_summary$module == "grey"
    ])
    tibble::tibble(
      power = current_power,
      assigned_gene_fraction = (10000L - grey_n) / 10000L,
      grey_fraction = grey_n / 10000L,
      module_n = length(assigned_sizes),
      minimum_module_size_observed = min(assigned_sizes),
      median_module_size = stats::median(assigned_sizes),
      maximum_module_size = max(assigned_sizes),
      n_blocks = current_result$n_blocks,
      raw_undersized_module_n = sum(
        current_result$module_audit$below_declared_minimum
      )
    )
  }
)

adjacent_power_pairs <- tibble::tibble(
  reference_power = power_sensitivity_candidates[-length(power_sensitivity_candidates)],
  alternative_power = power_sensitivity_candidates[-1]
)
power_adjacent_preservation <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  adjacent_power_pairs,
  function(reference_power, alternative_power) {
    reference_result <- power_network_results[[paste0("P", reference_power)]]
    alternative_result <- power_network_results[[paste0("P", alternative_power)]]
    wgcna_match_modules(
      reference_colors = reference_result$colors,
      alternative_colors = alternative_result$colors,
      reference_eigengenes = reference_result$eigengenes,
      projected_alternative_eigengenes = alternative_result$eigengenes,
      max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        reference_power = reference_power,
        alternative_power = alternative_power,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

set.seed(power_sensitivity_seed)
power_resample_design <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(power_resample_replicates),
  function(resample_id) {
    retained_samples <- metadata_aligned %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$station_tag %in% site_order) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$station_tag) %>%
      dplyr::slice_sample(n = power_resample_libraries_per_site) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        match(.data$station_tag, site_order),
        .data$sample_code
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$sample_code)
    tibble::tibble(
      resample_id = resample_id,
      retained_samples_list = list(retained_samples),
      retained_samples = paste(retained_samples, collapse = ";")
    )
  }
)

run_power_resample <- function(power, resample_id,
                               retained_samples_list, retained_samples) {
  current_power <- power
  reference_result <- power_network_results[[paste0("P", current_power)]]
  current_signature <- paste(
    power_cache_signature_base,
    paste0("power=", current_power),
    paste0("resample_id=", resample_id),
    paste0("samples=", retained_samples),
    sep = "||"
  )
  cache_file <- file.path(
    power_resample_cache_dir,
    paste0(
      "P", current_power, "_resample_",
      sprintf("%02d", resample_id), "_",
      digest::digest(current_signature, algo = "xxhash64"),
      ".rds"
    )
  )
  if (reuse_power_sensitivity_cache && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    if (is.list(cached) && identical(cached$signature, current_signature)) {
      message("Reusing power/resample cache P", current_power, " R", resample_id)
      return(cached$result)
    }
  }
  set.seed(power_sensitivity_seed + current_power * 100L + resample_id)
  resampled_expression <- dat_expr_g10000[
    match(retained_samples_list, rownames(dat_expr_g10000)),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  alternative_result <- wgcna_run_validated_network(
    dat_expr = resampled_expression,
    power = current_power,
    network_type = network_type,
    correlation_type = correlation_type,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers,
    minimum_module_size = minimum_module_size,
    merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
    deep_split = deep_split,
    pam_respects_dendro = pam_respects_dendro,
    max_block_size = max_block_size,
    verbose = 0
  )
  projected_alternative <- wgcna_orient_eigengenes(
    dat_expr_g10000,
    alternative_result$colors,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
  )$eigengenes
  result <- wgcna_match_modules(
    reference_colors = reference_result$colors,
    alternative_colors = alternative_result$colors,
    reference_eigengenes = reference_result$eigengenes,
    projected_alternative_eigengenes = projected_alternative,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      power = current_power,
      resample_id = resample_id,
      retained_sample_n = length(retained_samples_list),
      .before = 1
    )
  saveRDS(
    list(signature = current_signature, result = result),
    cache_file,
    compress = FALSE
  )
  result
}

power_resampling_stability <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  power = power_sensitivity_candidates,
  resample_id = power_resample_design$resample_id
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(power_resample_design, by = "resample_id") %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(run_power_resample)

power_resampling_module_summary <- power_resampling_stability %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$power, .data$reference_module) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    module_median_resampling_jaccard = stats::median(
      .data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    module_minimum_resampling_jaccard = min(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    module_median_resampling_eigengene_agreement = stats::median(
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    module_reciprocal_match_fraction = mean(
      .data$reciprocal_match, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    candidate_moderate_resampling_module =
      .data$module_median_resampling_jaccard >=
      candidate_module_moderate_median_jaccard &
      .data$module_minimum_resampling_jaccard >=
      candidate_module_moderate_minimum_jaccard &
      .data$module_median_resampling_eigengene_agreement >=
      candidate_module_moderate_eigengene_agreement
  )

power_resampling_summary <- power_resampling_stability %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$power) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_resampling_jaccard = stats::median(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_resampling_jaccard = min(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_resampling_eigengene_agreement = stats::median(
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    reciprocal_match_fraction = mean(.data$reciprocal_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    power_resampling_module_summary %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$power) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        candidate_moderate_resampling_module_n = sum(
          .data$candidate_moderate_resampling_module
        ),
        candidate_moderate_resampling_module_fraction = mean(
          .data$candidate_moderate_resampling_module
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "power"
  )

adjacent_power_summary_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  power_adjacent_preservation %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      power = .data$reference_power,
      adjacent_pair = paste0(
        .data$reference_power, "-", .data$alternative_power
      ),
      .data$jaccard,
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation
    ),
  power_adjacent_preservation %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      power = .data$alternative_power,
      adjacent_pair = paste0(
        .data$reference_power, "-", .data$alternative_power
      ),
      .data$jaccard,
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation
    )
)
adjacent_power_summary <- adjacent_power_summary_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$power) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_adjacent_power_jaccard = stats::median(
      .data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_adjacent_power_jaccard = min(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_adjacent_power_eigengene_agreement = stats::median(
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

maximum_candidate_scale_free_fit <- max(
  g10000_soft_tbl$scale_free_fit,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
final_power_selection_table <- g10000_soft_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$power,
    signed_scale_free_fit = .data$scale_free_fit,
    .data$slope,
    .data$mean_connectivity,
    .data$median_connectivity
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(power_connectivity_distribution, by = "power") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(power_network_structure, by = "power") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(adjacent_power_summary, by = "power") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(power_resampling_summary, by = "power") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    scale_free_fit_deficit_from_tested_maximum =
      maximum_candidate_scale_free_fit - .data$signed_scale_free_fit,
    overly_sparse =
      .data$median_connectivity < adequate_median_connectivity_threshold,
    adequate_connectivity = !.data$overly_sparse,
    near_best_scale_free_fit =
      .data$scale_free_fit_deficit_from_tested_maximum <=
      maximum_scale_free_fit_deficit,
    adequate_resampling_stability =
      .data$candidate_moderate_resampling_module_n >= 1L,
    structurally_eligible =
      .data$adequate_connectivity &
      .data$near_best_scale_free_fit &
      .data$adequate_resampling_stability
  )

eligible_powers <- final_power_selection_table$power[
  final_power_selection_table$structurally_eligible
]
if (length(eligible_powers) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No tested power met the predeclared connectivity, fit-deficit, and ",
    "resampling-stability criteria."
  )
}
final_selected_power <- min(eligible_powers)
final_power_selection_table <- final_power_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected = .data$power == final_selected_power,
    decision = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$selected ~ paste(
        "selected: lowest structurally eligible power after scale-free-fit",
        "improvements became marginal"
      ),
      .data$overly_sparse ~
        "not selected: median connectivity below the declared adequacy threshold",
      !.data$near_best_scale_free_fit ~
        "not selected: scale-free-fit deficit exceeds the declared tolerance",
      !.data$adequate_resampling_stability ~ paste(
        "not selected: no module met the moderate resampling membership",
        "and eigengene thresholds"
      ),
      TRUE ~ "eligible but higher than the selected power"
    ),
    selection_uses_site_contrasts = FALSE,
    selection_uses_deg_overlap = FALSE,
    selection_uses_enrichment = FALSE,
    selection_uses_chemistry = FALSE
  )

final_power_result <- power_network_results[[
  paste0("P", final_selected_power)
]]
```

```{r power-decision-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
power_decision_plot <- final_power_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .data$power,
    `Scale-free fit` = .data$signed_scale_free_fit,
    `Median connectivity (scaled)` = .data$median_connectivity,
```

# 10. Final-power cross-universe preservation

The cross-universe confirmation below replaces the provisional 10,000-gene
power-20 membership with the structurally selected power-14 membership. This
prevents the final gene-universe dashboard from mixing provisional and final
network statistics.

```{r final-power-cross-universe-preservation}

final_g10000_deg_coverage <- planned_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::select(.data$contrast, .data$contrast_panel) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    network_label = "G10000",
    network_size = 10000L,
    total_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(

      ~dplyr::n_distinct(focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[
        focal_deg_tbl$contrast == .x
      ])
    ),
    eligible_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(
      .data$contrast,
      ~length(intersect(
        focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[focal_deg_tbl$contrast == .x],
        final_g10000_eligible_gene_ids
      ))
    ),
    assigned_significant_deg_n = purrr::map_int(
      .data$contrast,
      ~length(intersect(
        focal_deg_tbl$gene_id[focal_deg_tbl$contrast == .x],
        final_g10000_assigned_gene_ids
      ))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    eligible_deg_fraction = safe_divide(
      .data$eligible_significant_deg_n,
      .data$total_significant_deg_n
    ),
    assigned_deg_fraction_of_total = safe_divide(
      .data$assigned_significant_deg_n,
      .data$total_significant_deg_n
    ),
    assigned_deg_fraction_of_eligible = safe_divide(
      .data$assigned_significant_deg_n,
      .data$eligible_significant_deg_n
    )
  )
```

# 11. Site-stratified stability across gene universes

The same ten four-of-five-per-site resamples are used to compare the 5,000-,
10,000-, and 15,000-gene candidates. The 10,000-gene reference uses the
structurally selected power above; the other universes retain their independently
evaluated powers from the nested-universe analysis.

```{r gene-universe-resampling-stability, message=TRUE}
make_universe_reference <- function(network_label) {
  if (network_label == "G10000") {
    return(list(
      network_label = network_label,
      network_size = 10000L,
      power = final_selected_power,
      gene_ids = g10000_gene_ids,
      dat_expr = dat_expr_g10000,
      colors = final_power_result$colors,
      eigengenes = final_power_result$eigengenes
    ))
  }
  current_result <- network_results[[network_label]]
  current_gene_ids <- current_result$selected_gene_ids
  current_dat_expr <- t(
    expression_matrix[current_gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  rownames(current_dat_expr) <- metadata_aligned$sample_code
  current_colors <- stats::setNames(
    as.character(current_result$assignment$module),
    as.character(current_result$assignment$gene_id)
  )[colnames(current_dat_expr)]
  me_columns_current <- grep(
    "^ME", names(current_result$eigengenes), value = TRUE
  )
  current_me <- current_result$eigengenes %>%
    dplyr::slice(match(rownames(current_dat_expr), .data$sample_code)) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(me_columns_current)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(current_me) <- rownames(current_dat_expr)
  list(
    network_label = network_label,
    network_size = current_result$network_size,
    power = as.integer(current_result$summary$selected_power[[1]]),
    gene_ids = current_gene_ids,
    dat_expr = current_dat_expr,
    colors = current_colors,
    eigengenes = current_me
  )
}

universe_reference_objects <- purrr::map(
  paste0("G", gene_set_sizes),
  make_universe_reference
)
names(universe_reference_objects) <- paste0("G", gene_set_sizes)

universe_resample_cache_dir <- file.path(
  objects_dir, "gene_universe_resample_cache"
)
dir.create(
  universe_resample_cache_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

run_universe_resample <- function(network_label, resample_id,
                                  retained_samples_list, retained_samples) {
  reference <- universe_reference_objects[[network_label]]
  if (network_label == "G10000") {
    return(
      power_resampling_stability %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$power == final_selected_power,
          .data$resample_id == resample_id
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          network_label = network_label,
          network_size = 10000L,
          .before = 1
        )
    )
  }
  current_signature <- paste(
    power_cache_signature_base,
    paste0("universe=", network_label),
    paste0("gene_hash=", digest::digest(reference$gene_ids, algo = "xxhash64")),
    paste0("power=", reference$power),
    paste0("resample_id=", resample_id),
    paste0("samples=", retained_samples),
    sep = "||"
  )
  cache_file <- file.path(
    universe_resample_cache_dir,
    paste0(
      network_label, "_resample_", sprintf("%02d", resample_id), "_",
      digest::digest(current_signature, algo = "xxhash64"), ".rds"
    )
  )
  if (reuse_power_sensitivity_cache && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    if (is.list(cached) && identical(cached$signature, current_signature)) {
      message("Reusing universe/resample cache ", network_label, " R", resample_id)
      return(cached$result)
    }
  }
  set.seed(
    power_sensitivity_seed + reference$network_size + resample_id
  )
  resampled_expression <- reference$dat_expr[
    match(retained_samples_list, rownames(reference$dat_expr)),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  alternative <- wgcna_run_validated_network(
    dat_expr = resampled_expression,
    power = reference$power,
    network_type = network_type,
    correlation_type = correlation_type,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers,
    minimum_module_size = minimum_module_size,
    merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
    deep_split = deep_split,
    pam_respects_dendro = pam_respects_dendro,
    max_block_size = max_block_size,
    verbose = 0
  )
  projected_alternative <- wgcna_orient_eigengenes(
    reference$dat_expr,
    alternative$colors,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
  )$eigengenes
  result <- wgcna_match_modules(
    reference_colors = reference$colors,
    alternative_colors = alternative$colors,
    reference_eigengenes = reference$eigengenes,
    projected_alternative_eigengenes = projected_alternative,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      network_label = network_label,
      network_size = reference$network_size,
      power = reference$power,
      resample_id = resample_id,
      retained_sample_n = length(retained_samples_list),
      .before = 1
    )
  saveRDS(
    list(signature = current_signature, result = result),
    cache_file,
    compress = FALSE
  )
  result
}

gene_universe_resampling_stability <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  network_label = names(universe_reference_objects),
  resample_id = power_resample_design$resample_id
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(power_resample_design, by = "resample_id") %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(run_universe_resample)

gene_universe_resampling_summary <- gene_universe_resampling_stability %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$network_label, .data$network_size, .data$power) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_resampling_jaccard = stats::median(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_resampling_jaccard = min(.data$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_eigengene_agreement = stats::median(
      .data$eigengene_abs_correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    reciprocal_match_fraction = mean(.data$reciprocal_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv_safe(
  gene_universe_resampling_stability,
  file.path(tables_dir, "gene_universe_resampling_stability.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(

  file.path(tables_dir, "gene_universe_resampling_summary.csv")
)
knitr::kable(

  digits = 3,
  caption = "Site-stratified module stability across nested gene universes."
)
```

# 11. Integrated decision dashboard

The decision dashboard contains only structural criteria plus annotation
coverage as a secondary practical consideration. Site-contrast significance,
DEG recovery, and functional yield are exported in a separate downstream
sensitivity table and cannot affect the network choice.

```{r decision-dashboard}

      .data$median_jaccard,

  dplyr::mutate(
```

## Selected network for the downstream exploratory rerun

The 10,000-gene universe is selected as the smallest expanded network that
retains much of the 5,000-gene structure without the greater fragmentation and
weaker incremental preservation of the 15,000-gene expansion. Its improved
annotation coverage is a secondary practical benefit. DEG recovery, site
significance, enrichment yield, and chemistry do not enter this decision.

