```{r selected-network-handoff}
  ),
  permitted_for_selection = c(
    rep(TRUE, 7),
    rep("secondary", 3),
    rep(TRUE, 3)
  )
)
write_csv_safe(
  selection_evidence,
  file.path(tables_dir, "selected_wgcna_network_evidence.csv")
)

project_relative_path <- function(path) {
  absolute_path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  project_prefix <- paste0(project_dir, "/")
  if (startsWith(absolute_path, project_prefix)) {
    substring(absolute_path, nchar(project_prefix) + 1L)
  } else {
    absolute_path
  }
}

selected_network_manifest <- tibble::tibble(
  selection_status = "final_selected_for_step08",
  selection_rule = paste(
    "10,000 genes selected from structural cross-universe preservation,",
    "resampling stability, connectivity and module assignment; annotation",
    "coverage used only secondarily; site, DEG, enrichment and chemistry",
    "results excluded. Power is the lowest structurally eligible candidate"
  ),
  selected_network_label = selected_network_label,
  selected_gene_set_size = selected_gene_set_size,
  selected_power = selected_network_summary$selected_power,
  soft_threshold_target = soft_threshold_target,
  soft_threshold_target_reached = selected_network_summary$target_reached,
  network_type = network_type,
  correlation_type = correlation_type,
  max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers,
  minimum_module_size = minimum_module_size,
  merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
  deep_split = deep_split,
  pam_respects_dendro = pam_respects_dendro,
  max_block_size = max_block_size,
  n_blocks = selected_network_summary$n_blocks,
  wgcna_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("WGCNA")),
  eigengene_orientation_rule =
    "positive correlation with average standardized member-gene expression",
  undersized_module_policy =
    "reclassify post-blockwise non-grey groups below minModuleSize to exact grey",
  gene_membership_file = project_relative_path(selected_membership_file),
  module_eigengenes_by_sample_file = project_relative_path(
    selected_eigengene_sample_file
  ),
  module_eigengenes_by_site_file = project_relative_path(
    selected_eigengene_site_file
  ),
  module_summary_file = project_relative_path(selected_module_summary_file),
  soft_threshold_diagnostics_file = project_relative_path(
    selected_soft_diagnostics_file
  ),
  soft_threshold_decision_file = project_relative_path(
    selected_soft_decision_file
  ),
  eigengene_orientation_file = project_relative_path(selected_orientation_file),
  module_identity_audit_file = project_relative_path(
    selected_module_identity_audit_file
  ),
  final_power_selection_file = project_relative_path(
    file.path(tables_dir, "final_power_selection_table.csv")
  )
)
write_csv_safe(
  selected_network_manifest,
  file.path(tables_dir, "selected_wgcna_network_manifest.csv")
)

knitr::kable(
  selected_network_manifest %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$selected_network_label,
      .data$selected_gene_set_size,
      .data$selected_power,
      .data$soft_threshold_target_reached,
      .data$n_blocks,
      .data$max_block_size
    ),
  caption = "WGCNA network selected for the final site-associated module analysis."
)
knitr::kable(
  selection_evidence,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Evidence retained with the selected-network decision."
)
```

```{r decision-notes, results='asis'}
cat("## Reading the comparison\n\n")

if (all(!network_summary$target_reached)) {
  cat(
    "None of the tested gene sets reached the prespecified scale-free-topology target. ",
    "The final network should therefore not be described as scale-free, and gene-set selection should rely on the combined diagnostics rather than on this statistic alone.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  reached_sizes <- network_summary$requested_gene_n[
    network_summary$target_reached
  ]
  cat(
    "The scale-free-topology target was reached by: ",
    paste(format(reached_sizes, big.mark = ","), collapse = ", "),
    " genes. This remains one network diagnostic rather than a sufficient selection criterion.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

if (nrow(final_universe_preservation_summary) > 0L) {
  best_preservation <- final_universe_preservation_summary %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(.data$median_jaccard),
      dplyr::desc(.data$median_abs_eigengene_cor)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1)

  cat(
    "The strongest overall cross-size module preservation occurred for the ",
    format(best_preservation$reference_size, big.mark = ","),
    " to ",
    format(best_preservation$test_size, big.mark = ","),
    " comparison (median Jaccard = ",
    sprintf("%.3f", best_preservation$median_jaccard),
    "; median absolute eigengene correlation = ",
    sprintf("%.3f", best_preservation$median_abs_eigengene_cor),
    ").\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

cat(
  "The 10,000-gene universe is selected from structural evidence: cross-universe preservation, site-stratified resampling stability, connectivity, assignment, and module-size behaviour. Annotation coverage is secondary. Site-contrast significance, DEG recovery, enrichment yield, and chemistry were excluded from selection. Within the 10,000-gene universe, power ",
  final_selected_power,
  " is the lowest candidate meeting the declared connectivity, scale-free-fit-deficit, and resampling-stability criteria. Step 08 consumes this explicit final-network handoff.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# 9. Save the lightweight comparison object

```{r save-lightweight-object}
lightweight_results <- list(
  settings = list(
    gene_set_sizes = gene_set_sizes,
    candidate_powers = candidate_powers,
    soft_threshold_target = soft_threshold_target,
    reference_power_for_comparison = reference_power_for_comparison,
    network_type = network_type,
    correlation_type = correlation_type,
    max_p_outliers = max_p_outliers,
    minimum_module_size = minimum_module_size,
    merge_cut_height = merge_cut_height,
    deep_split = deep_split,
    pam_respects_dendro = pam_respects_dendro,
    max_block_size = max_block_size,
    planned_contrasts = planned_contrasts
  ),
  network_summary = network_summary,
  soft_threshold = soft_threshold_all,
  module_summary = module_summary_all,
  module_assignments = purrr::map(
    network_results,
    "assignment"
  ),
  eigengenes = purrr::map(
    network_results,
    "eigengenes"
  ),
  planned_contrasts = planned_contrasts_all,
  module_preservation = module_preservation,
  contrast_preservation = contrast_preservation,
  annotation_coverage = network_gene_coverage,
  deg_coverage = deg_coverage,
  decision_dashboard = decision_dashboard
  , power_selection = final_power_selection_table
  , power_adjacent_preservation = power_adjacent_preservation
  , power_resampling_stability = power_resampling_stability
  , gene_universe_resampling_stability = gene_universe_resampling_stability
  , final_power_module_preservation = final_universe_module_preservation
  , final_power_preservation_summary = final_universe_preservation_summary
)

saveRDS(
  lightweight_results,
  file.path(
    objects_dir,
    "wgcna_gene_set_sensitivity_lightweight.rds"
  ),
  compress = "xz"
)
```
